g.text: Shrinkage level λ (logit scale; 0 = sample correlation, 1 = diagonal)
Effective rank, share of the genes (log scale)
Welch panel, standard Wnt. Lines: (1 − λ) R + λ I for each cell type; dashed: level chosen by the bulk likelihood; point: level chosen per type by held-out cells.
Effective rank: (Σ ℓ)² / Σ ℓ² of the eigenvalues ℓ, as a share of the genes.
Shrinkage brings κ from up to 1.3 million (λ = 0.001) to at most 1,726 at the level chosen by the bulk likelihood
